summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor with story CRUD-like queries, a React frontend with TOC + story reader routes, speech-synthesis narration controls, and a client-side “PDF” export via building printable HTML. Several key requirements are not demonstrably met from the diff summary (notably: ensuring exactly 20 stories starting from Creation, and shipping the required static generated images). The diff also introduces authentication-related wiring and external attribution that were not requested and appears to touch files listed as immutable in the BuildRequest constraints.

missing_requirements.requirement: Exactly 20 stories starting from Creation must exist and be shown in an in-app Table of Contents in order.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend only defines an empty Map and an `addStory` method, but no seeded/stored initial set of 20 stories (including Creation) is shown. Frontend TOC renders whatever `getAllStories()` returns, which could be empty and is not guaranteed to be exactly 20 or to start with Creation.
evidence: backend/main.mo (stories initialized empty; only addStory enforces max 20)

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate one combined, downloadable PDF containing all 20 stories (cover + each story illustration + separate coloring page section).
missing_requirements.reason: PDF export implementation is truncated and its described behavior indicates opening the browser print dialog rather than generating a directly downloadable PDF file. Additionally, the truncated `exportEbookPdf.ts` does not clearly show inclusion of the coloring page for each story or that it always includes all 20 stories in order.
evidence: frontend/src/components/DownloadPdfButton.tsx (comment: 'the print dialog will open', title: 'Opens print dialog to save as PDF')
frontend/src/features/pdf/exportEbookPdf.ts (truncated; only cover + story page start shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Ship all required generated illustration + coloring page images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
missing_requirements.reason: Code references the expected asset paths, but the diff summary does not include any added image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` (an omitted file is mentioned but not evidenced as the full required asset set). Therefore, it is not verifiable that the required images are actually included.
evidence: File diff summary (no listed additions under frontend/public/assets/generated; omitted files due to limits: added=1)

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication provider wiring (InternetIdentityProvider/useInternetIdentity/useActor identity-based actor recreation), despite auth not being required for this build.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly states authentication is not required; diff adds and uses Internet Identity provider and identity-aware actor logic.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (uses useInternetIdentity identity logic to create actor)

hallucinated_features.description: Footer attribution link to caffeine.ai with referral parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest requirements or acceptance criteria.
evidence: frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx (footer includes caffeine.ai link with UTM params)

hallucinated_features.description: Backend mutation method `addStory` with caller parameter (shared) even though only query methods for reading were required.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-5 requires query methods to fetch story list/by id; adding write APIs was not requested.
